question:
From the options given below choose the synonym (similar meaning) of the word:

Decapitate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option(1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Decapitate"** means to cut off the head of a person or an animal. (सिर काट देना)

 
 
• **Example:** In ancient times, some people were punished by** decapitation** for certain crimes.
 
 
 
• **"Behead"** means to remove the head of a person or animal, similar to the word decapitate. (सिर काटना)
 
 
• **Example:** Historical accounts mention that some criminals were **beheaded** as punishment.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Behead**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Feeble** (कमज़ोर): Lacking physical strength, especially as a result of age or illness.

 
 
• **Example:** After his illness, he felt too feeble to even walk across the room.
 
 
 
• **Invigorate** (ताकत देना): To give strength or energy to someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** A brisk walk in the morning always invigorates her for the day ahead.
 
 
 
• **Affection** (स्नेह): A gentle feeling of fondness or liking.
 
 
• **Example:** He showed great affection for his pet dog.
